summary: Phases 1-3 complete: captured pre-fix evidence/census, replaced all 14 z3.Int sites with z3.FreshInt, added a permanent zero-solve structural regression guard (teeth-checked). Proceeding to Phase 4 (rewrite defect-enshrining tests) and Phase 5 (dead false_at deadness proof).
decisions_made: Phase 1 discrepancy: the plan expected exactly 2 non-bot folded survivors; measured 4 (temporal-only)/7 (full population). Extra survivors are genuine propositional/modal tautologies structurally outside the defect's blast radius (no quantified operator, or box-only/immune). Recorded, not silently resolved; core mechanism claim intact.

Phase 2 secondary finding: Box(p)->Box(p) (sibling, not nested) stops folding post-fix due to FreshInt breaking term-identity-based simplify() shortcuts Z3 used pre-fix; not a soundness issue and not in scope to fix, recorded for Phase 6-8 to account for.

Phase 3 guard excludes structurally-immune formulas (no quantified operator; box-only) rather than an index allowlist, so it stays correct if the enumerator population changes composition (though it hard-asserts population size == 274).
